## About
Prime Complete Auto Services is a collision center in North Long Beach. We fix cosmetic and structural damage, bumpers, paint and glass, and we handle mechanical work too.
Our mission is simple: keep your car on the road. That means quality repairs, clear and transparent pricing, and a repair process that's as hassle-free as we can make it.
Neighbors know us as Frank's shop, and a lot of folks come in because a friend sent them. We're rated 4.8 from 30 Google reviews, and we'd like to earn yours.

## Services
- Collision repair: Cosmetic and structural vehicle repair, bumper repair and paint repair.
- Free estimate: We look over the damage and give you a cost projection for the repairs, with no obligation.
- Insurance claim process: We guide you through the claim, talk with your provider and make sure repairs are documented the way they ask.
- Paintless dent removal: Minor dents and dings taken out without touching the original paint finish.
- Windshield & glass replacement: We remove damaged glass, clean the area and install new glass to the manufacturer's standards.
- Mechanical repair: Diagnosis, maintenance and repair for engine, transmission, suspension, brakes and electrical.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: Yes. We work with all major insurance companies to help the repair go smoothly.

Q: How long will my repair take?
A: It depends on the damage, the repairs needed and parts availability. Either way, we'll give you updates while your car is with us.

Q: How much will it cost?
A: That depends on the damage, the parts and materials, and the labor involved. We always give you transparent pricing.

Q: Do you offer a warranty on your repairs?
A: Yes. Our workmanship is covered for as long as you own the car, and parts carry the manufacturer's warranty. If something isn't right, bring it back and we'll make it right.
